metadata.description: Thomas Kejser's personal Claude Code plugins — coding conventions and workflow skills.

plugins.name: kejser-web
plugins.description: SvelteKit stack and conventions: default stack and scaffolding, every UX control is a component, semantic CSS with no Tailwind, and adapter-node deploys.

plugins.name: kejser-code
plugins.description: Language-agnostic and C++ conventions: minimal contract-only comments, fail loudly, modern C++, SQL and database design, Markdown style, and how agents commit and report in shared trees.
